name: voice-agents-app
//: ONE Next.js app with three modes (Transcribe | Translate | Assist).
This is a Node project (not a Python uv project). Install with `npm install`, run with `npm run dev`.
Version pins use ^ (caret) lower bounds so `npm install` fetches the latest compatible release,
then package-lock.json (written by npm install) locks the exact tree for reproducible installs.
Commit package-lock.json so a classmate gets the identical dependency tree.

scripts.//dev: The --require preload works around a DEV-ONLY Next/React crash ('RangeError: Map maximum size exceeded' from React's async-debug hook). See scripts/disable-react-async-debug.cjs. cross-env makes the env var work on Windows too. Production (build/start) is unaffected and does not use it.
